notes: Default is layout A. A/B/C each provide a complete parts replacement (meshes, textures, colliders, transformed joints) and actual seven diameter-22.3 bores through BOTH sheet roof and dark panel. B mirrors device centres, not lettering. C pilot u values were unspecified and retain A's -60/0/+60 at v170. Panel 280 along u x 190 along slope is centred on the roof. The nominal 200 X x 320 Y base is centred at X=-6 mm; a rear gland protrudes 12 mm, giving the combined visual bottom-centre origin at zero and bbox 212 x 320 x 160 mm. Nameplate is recessed flush on robot-right (-Y). Thin sheet edge rounding is 0.3 mm because a general 1 mm edge radius cannot fit 1.5 mm stock; plan corners retain R3. The six prescribed shell colliders intentionally fill mounting holes, and their roof is expanded outward 0.75 mm to approximate the additional 1.5 mm dark panel within 1 mm. The gland has a separate fixed collider. Actuator/support contact exclusions are explicitly supplied for these simplified colliders. At the prescribed 15 mm legend offset, 30 x 10 plates overlap 29.5 mm bezels and the 60 mm emergency disc: exact centre positions are retained; upper label edges sit under the trim, and the emergency legend is mostly obscured by its correctly printed yellow disc. This unavoidable placement conflict is not resolved by moving the mandated centres. Static trim/legend intersections are visual-only and adjacent fixed bodies should be welded or have contacts excluded by the scene importer. The selector's neutral geometry, endpoint detents, spring and latch conventions are inherited from panel_devices; simulator behaviour is metadata, not an executed dynamics demonstration. Recommended per-layout placements put all four actuation centres in x300-480 mm, |y|30-450 mm, z800-1000 mm; pilots need not be pressed. Enclosure mass absorbs the remainder so each complete layout totals exactly 4 kg. All geometry/UVs/normal exports share the console frame. Full Principled PBR and source printing images are packed in source.blend; preview_B/C show the other real layouts. 64-sample CPU Cycles DIFFUSE COLOR * (0.4 + 0.6 * AO); 8-bit sRGB; no direct/highlight bake. Collision refinement: all six shell proxies have clipped R3 plan footprints, with at most 56 vertices each; rounded wall-strip corner underfill is less than 0.63 mm. Roof is extruded along the true normal, from -1.5 to +0.75 mm, so rim overhang also remains under 1 mm. Button/head proxy diameters are 23/39.6 mm to follow their stepped/rounded boundaries. v is measured from the full roof's front edge; the centred dark insert starts at v16.8034 mm. Convex proxy topology is rebuilt from unchanged one-micrometre OBJ points after export rounding. Legend ink is enlarged vertically and placed in the lower band of each unchanged 30 x 10 mm plate, keeping text clear of the bezel at the prescribed 15 mm plate-centre offset; the emergency plate remains occluded by the mandatory 60 mm yellow disc. Task 13 compact OBJ exception: positions use 5 decimal metres where safe; necessary vertices retain up to 6 decimals to preserve nonzero triangles, strict collision convexity and the 0.005 mm Euclidean movement bound. Independent fixed-5 rounding cannot satisfy all three. Normals/UVs use 4 decimals; every original triangle, position index and per-corner attribute value is retained. Equal rounded UV records share indices and visual OBJ indices use shorter equivalent relative notation. No collision remeshing, reindexing or simplification. Task 13 delivery: baked albedos are Lanczos-downsampled to at most 1024 px except the unchanged-resolution factory-floor repeat tile; previews are 512 square. PNG encoding uses RGB8 or reviewed 256-colour Floyd-Steinberg palettes; source artwork pixels and source.blend are retained. Shared PNG paths resolve from this prop folder.
